# Address waits

Waiting on a word and waking its waiters through `_umtx_op`.

<h2 id="umtx-op-wait-uint-private"><code>UMTX_OP_WAIT_UINT_PRIVATE</code></h2>

```rux
pub const UMTX_OP_WAIT_UINT_PRIVATE: int32 = 15;
```

`UMTX_OP_WAIT_UINT_PRIVATE`: sleep while a 32-bit word holds the expected value.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Umtx.rux#L13)

<h2 id="umtx-op-wake-private"><code>UMTX_OP_WAKE_PRIVATE</code></h2>

```rux
pub const UMTX_OP_WAKE_PRIVATE: int32 = 16;
```

`UMTX_OP_WAKE_PRIVATE`: wake threads sleeping on the word.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Umtx.rux#L18)

<h2 id="umtx-wait"><code>UmtxWait</code></h2>

```rux
pub func UmtxWait(
    address: *uint32,
    expected: uint32,
    timeout: *Timespec
) -> int64
```

Sleeps while `*address` equals `expected`, until a wake, a signal or the timeout.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=_umtx_op&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=_umtx_op&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Umtx.rux#L27)

**Parameters**

| Name       | Type        | Description                                                                |
| ---------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `address`  | `*uint32`   | the word to wait on, four-byte aligned                                     |
| `expected` | `uint32`    | the value the caller last saw there                                        |
| `timeout`  | `*Timespec` | how long to wait at most, relative to now, or null to wait without a limit |

**Returns**: zero after a wake or when the word already differs, or a negative error number: [`EINTR`](/docs/api/freebsd/errors#eintr) or [`ETIMEDOUT`](/docs/api/freebsd/errors#etimedout)

<h2 id="umtx-wake"><code>UmtxWake</code></h2>

```rux
pub func UmtxWake(address: *uint32, count: int32) -> int64
```

Wakes up to `count` threads sleeping on `address`.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=_umtx_op&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=_umtx_op&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Umtx.rux#L39)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type      | Description              |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------ |
| `address` | `*uint32` | the word they wait on    |
| `count`   | `int32`   | how many to wake at most |

**Returns**: zero, or a negative error number
